welcome_title: Classes 5 to 12, NEET, JEE and CUET, in Bengali and English
welcome_body: Live classes, recorded lectures and timed mock tests in one place.
join_free_hint: This batch is free — join it to see it in your batches and get notices/live-class alerts.
upi_steps: Pay the amount below, then enter the UTR from your payment app and upload a screenshot.
payment_pending: Payment submitted. We'll approve it shortly.
payment_pending_note: Approval usually takes a few hours.
already_submitted: You have already submitted this test.
doubt_soon: Ask doubts to teachers here. This opens in a later update.

payment_pending_exists: You already have a payment waiting for approval for this batch.
coupon_invalid: This coupon isn't valid for this batch.
verify_human: Complete the check below to continue.
image_too_large: Could not shrink the screenshot enough. Try a cropped one.
step1_b: Use Google, or an email and password. Create an account the first time.
step2_b: We use it to show the right batches first. You can change it later in Profile.
step3_b: Watch a free lecture or take a daily test. Enroll in a paid batch when you're ready.
reset_sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way. Check spam too.
first_time_hint: New here? You only need a Google account, or any email and a password.
same_method: Use the same sign-in method every time.
err_invalid_credential: Email or password is incorrect. First time here? Choose Create account.
err_email_in_use: This email already has an account. Sign in instead, or use Google if you signed up with it.
err_weak_password: Use at least 6 characters for the password.
err_invalid_email: That email address doesn't look right.
err_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, or reset your password.
err_network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
err_other_method: This email is registered with another sign-in method. Try Continue with Google.
err_popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups, or sign in with email.
class_hint: Used to show the right batches first.
admin_forbidden: You don't have access to this.
admin_confirm_block_body: {name} won't be able to sign in until unblocked.
admin_confirm_unblock_body: {name} will be able to sign in again.
teach_intro: Apply to teach. An admin reviews every application.
teach_bio_hint: 20 to 600 characters. Students see this on your batches.
teach_pending_body: We'll update this page once an admin decides.
teach_approved_body: Your teacher tools open here once batches are assigned to you.
teach_staff: Your account already has staff access.
admin_confirm_suspend_body: {name} will lose the teacher tools and be unassigned from all batches. Their content stays.
already_staff: Your account already has staff access.
role_select_title: How will you use the app?
role_select_body: Pick one — you can tell us more right after.
role_select_student_body: Join batches, watch lectures, take tests and clear doubts.
role_select_teacher_body: Apply to teach — fill a short form and our team will review it.
register_title_teacher_body: Just your name and number — the next step is your teaching application.
admin_no_teachers_available: No more approved teachers to assign. Approve applications in the Teachers tab.
admin_batch_id_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
admin_batch_id_locked: The ID is fixed once created.
batch_status_hint_draft: Hidden from students. Use this while you set things up.
batch_status_hint_published: Visible in the catalogue. Students can enroll.
batch_status_hint_archived: Hidden from new students. Enrolled students keep access.
admin_warn_no_teacher: This batch is published but has no teacher assigned yet.
admin_preview_video_hint: Paste a YouTube link or the 11-character video ID.
admin_video_invalid: That is not a YouTube link or video ID.
admin_delete_notice_body: Students will no longer see it. This cannot be undone.
admin_subject_id_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, for example organic_chemistry.
admin_subjects_intro: Subjects appear in teacher applications and batch assignments. Turning one off hides it from new choices but keeps existing ones.
invalid_subject: One of the subjects is not available.
batch_id_taken: A batch with this ID already exists.
subject_id_taken: A subject with this ID already exists.
not_a_teacher: That person is not an approved teacher.
not_found: Not found. It may have been removed.
cannot_change_self: You can't change your own account here.
admin_confirm_grant_teacher_body: {name} keeps their admin role and can also use the teacher tools and be assigned to batches.
admin_confirm_revoke_teacher_body: {name} will lose the teacher tools and be unassigned from all batches. Their admin role is unchanged.
teach_no_students: No students in your batches yet
admin_delete_material_body: Students will no longer see it.
admin_lecture_id_hint: Link this to a specific lecture, or leave blank for general batch material.
admin_drive_file_id_hint: The ID from the Drive share link, not the whole URL.
admin_delete_banner_body: It will stop showing on the home screen.
doubt_intro: Ask a question about any batch and a teacher will answer it here.
doubt_drive_hint: Take or choose a photo of your question, if you have one.
doubt_sent: Sent. A teacher will answer soon.
admin_delete_lecture_body: Students will no longer see it in the batch.
admin_youtube_id_hint: Paste the full YouTube link, or just the video id — either works.
admin_live_at_hint: Shown on the student's home screen under "Today's live classes" around this time.
admin_delete_test_body: Students will lose access to it, including past attempts.
admin_test_batch_hint: Leave as "All batches" for an open test series (e.g. a scholarship test).
admin_test_negative_mark_hint: Marks deducted for each wrong answer, e.g. 1.
admin_question_answer_hint: Must exactly match one of the options above.
admin_bulk_hint:
One question per line: subject|type|question text|option1;option2;option3|correct answer|marks
Type is one of: mcq, assertion_reason, true_false, match, case_based.
teach_batch_required_hint: Only your own batches — a teacher can't post a notice to everyone.
not_your_batch: That batch isn't assigned to you.
guardian_aware: A parent or guardian is aware I'm creating this account, and I agree to our
guardian_required: Please confirm a parent or guardian is aware before continuing.
legal_preamble: By continuing you agree to our
already_enrolled: You are already enrolled in this batch.
turnstile_failed: Verification failed. Please wait a moment and try again.
invalid_input: Some details look wrong. Please check them and try again.
batch_is_free: This batch is free, so no payment is needed.
batch_not_free: This batch requires payment — use Enroll instead.
admin_batch_banner_hint: A 16:9 image link that starts with https://. Students see it on this batch.
push_unsupported: Notifications aren't supported on this device.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Enable them in your browser/app settings.
teach_public_body: Apply in a few minutes. An admin reviews every application and you're notified either way.
admin_image_failed: This link does not open as an image. Use a direct image link. Public Google Drive share links are converted automatically.
admin_release_hint: Leave empty to open at once. Until then students see the lecture as locked, without the video.
already_enrolled_hint: This batch is open for you. Go and start learning.
under_review_hint: We will open this batch for you as soon as the payment is approved. You do not need to pay again.
batch_free_hint: Everyone can open this batch, so there is nothing to pay.
payment_rejected_hint: Your last payment could not be approved. Check the details and try again.
avatar_first_hint: Pick an avatar or upload your own photo. You can change it any time from the three-dot menu on your profile.
goal_hint: Used to show the right batches first.
teach_profile_hint: Students see this on your batch pages. Changes go live as soon as you save.
learn_empty_hint: Enrol in a batch and it will appear here with all its lectures, notes and tests.
learn_locked_title: This lecture is not open yet
learn_locked_hint: Your teacher has not released it yet.
learn_this_lecture: Notes and DPP for this lecture
learn_tests_hint: Chapter tests, mocks and past papers
err_native_timeout: Google sign-in didn't respond. This is a known issue on some phones — try again, or sign in with email instead.
ai_chat_empty: Ask any question from your syllabus. The AI answers in your exam’s style.
ai_disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Check important answers with your teacher.
ai_draft_hint: An AI draft appears only if the answer box is empty. Read it, fix anything wrong, then send.
review_not_answered: You did not answer this one.
ai_gen_note: AI-written drafts in the chosen exam’s pattern. Check every question and answer before you publish.
ai_limit_reached: You have used today’s AI help. It resets tomorrow.
ai_busy: AI help is very busy right now. Please try again later.
ai_unavailable: AI help is not available right now. Your teacher can still answer.
ai_no_questions: The AI could not write usable questions. Try a more specific topic.
ai_off_topic: I can only help with your studies. Ask a question from your syllabus.
ai_blocked: AI help is paused for today.
ai_paused_in_test: AI help is switched off while a test is running. Finish your test first.
ai_profile_not_mcq: This exam style is written, so questions cannot be generated. Choose an MCQ style.
forbidden: You do not have access to this.
drive_picker_failed: Couldn't open the Drive picker. You can paste a Drive link or file ID instead.
admin_youtube_id_invalid: Couldn't find a video id in that — check the link.
admin_delete_chapter_body: Lectures and notes in it keep their content — they just lose this grouping.
admin_confirm_revoke_invite_body: They will no longer become a teacher automatically if they sign up with this email.
doubt_batch_hint: Your doubt goes to this batch’s teachers and to the admin.
notif_user_hint: The user ID shown for that person under People.
notif_delete_body: It will disappear from everyone’s inbox.
admin_banner_kind_launch_hint: Promotional banners on the home slider, with the batch’s name, fee, start date and a button.
admin_banner_kind_community_hint: Banners at the top of the Doubt tab: helpline, support hours, rules, group links, urgent notices.
admin_banner_desc_hint: Short text under the banner. If empty, the batch’s own summary is shown.
admin_banner_rules_hint: Doubt-solving rules, guidelines or an urgent announcement.
admin_banner_cta_hint: Where the button takes a student.
admin_support_buttons_hint: Up to three: WhatsApp or Telegram group links (https://…) or a phone number (tel:+91…).
admin_banner_schedule_hint: Leave both empty to show it right away until you switch it off.
admin_mrp_hint: Optional. Shown struck through beside the fee on banners.
teach_notify_hint: Goes to the students of the batch you choose, and to no one else.
teach_notify_no_batches: You have no batches assigned yet.
